About Raditeq 
Raditeq is a high-tech company focused on the development of EMC/RF measuring equipment. We do everything ourselves: from design and development to production and support. With a team of approximately 25 colleagues, we build equipment every day that enables our customers worldwide to perform accurate and reliable measurements. What do we ask? - A completed MBO or HBO Marketing (related) education - Interested in marketing, sales and market analyses - Ability to gather market information and analyze trends - Proactive work attitude and the ability to work well in a team - Interest in technology 
Strong communication skills in: - Dutch - English What do we offer? - A market-rate salary - Career Opportunities - A role where you can travel and work internationally
